partitionNote: The single Wisconsin track is blocked as a pleading on instrument-class grounds rather than evidence grounds. Wis. Stat. § 973.015(1m)(b) makes issuance of the certificate mandatory on successful completion, and the follow-up request is a letter to the supervising or detaining authority. Lane C3 owns only the court-pleading renderer, so the track is routed to the participant-correspondence lane and recommended for reclassification.

tracks.legalName: Participant Request that the Supervising or Detaining Authority Issue and Forward the Certificate of Discharge (Wis. Stat. § 973.015(1m)(b))
tracks.note: Blocked as a pleading because the correct output is participant correspondence to an executive authority, not a court filing. The registry states 'Not a court filing.' The merits are not in doubt — the registry says the correspondence is to be drafted — but the controlled custom-pleading renderer cannot express a letter, and rendering one as a pleading would fabricate a court proceeding against the authority. Recommended for reclassification off custom_pleading.
